name: Superstep
description: Open-source visual LangGraph studio: design, run and trace agent workflows.

STUDIO_ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Email of the first admin. The account is created at the first start; its one-time password is in the app log (heroku logs). Or set STUDIO_ADMIN_PASSWORD.

STUDIO_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Optional: password for that admin (8+ characters, a letter and a digit). Empty = generated and printed once in the log.

STUDIO_SECRET_KEY.description: Encrypts stored credentials. Keep it: changing it makes them unreadable.

STUDIO_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional: the app's https URL (https://<app>.herokuapp.com or your domain), for links in emails and Slack/Telegram callbacks.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional: OpenAI API key. Empty = sample answers.
